chronos_gateway.description: Chronos control surface authority for coordination and terminal routing.

chronos_localadmin.description: Chronos local admin authority for deterministic mission, runtime, and surface control from the local control plane.

chronos_mirror_v2.description: Chronos UI mirror authority for interacting with the orchestration system and observability logs.

chronos_operator.description: Chronos operator authority for read-only mission visibility and runtime observability.

chronos_tenant_runner.description: Chronos tenant-scoped pipeline runner. Entered ONLY in the child process chronos spawns for a schedule discovered under knowledge/confidential/{tenant}/pipelines/ (and, in the daemon, synchronously while listing/reading that tenant's pipeline files), always bound to that tenant (KYBERION_TENANT / execution-scope tenant, KYBERION_TENANT_SCOPE_REQUIRED=1 in the child). Grants resolve through ${KYBERION_TENANT}, so reads are limited to the bound tenant's confidential root plus the tenant registry; knowledge landings go through ingest:commit (ingest_commit role); writes are limited to that tenant's audit/trace mirrors.

chronos_token_registry_reader.description: TR-01: least-privilege reader of the Chronos viewer token registry (knowledge/personal/connections/chronos-access.json, SHA-256 token hashes only). Surfaces launched with a SYSTEM_ROLE that cannot read the personal tier assume it only to resolve a bearer/cookie viewer token; it grants no other read and no role write grant (persona worker, so only the worker persona and default_allow write paths remain).

cyber_security.description: Security review authority for threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, and mission veto power.

daemon_watchdog.description: EV-02: heartbeat watchdog authority. Observes daemon liveness and raises governed recovery wake triggers. Deliberately has no write scope over daemon state or repo config — it reports and requests, it does not reconfigure.

designer.description: Visual identity and UX authority for interaction design and design-system stewardship.

dot_lifecycle_writer.description: Writes dot charters (dots/) and the lifecycle audit ledger during governed status transitions (kyberion dot activate/pause/retire). Deliberately separate from any role a dot may bind at runtime, so an active dot can never rewrite the contract it runs under.

ecosystem_architect.description: Core architecture and repo evolution authority.

evaluate_model_role_fitness.description: TC-15: role-fitness evaluator authority. Runs the governed model role-fitness probes and appends their verdicts. Its only write scope is that journal — it measures models, it never staffs, dispatches or reconfigures anything.

first_job_tenant_status_reader.description: CLI-only first-job diagnostic operational-status reader. Entered only after current strict charter, server mapping, exact durable request and infrastructure_sentinel tenant/organization binding are validated. Reads exactly knowledge/personal/tenants/${KYBERION_TENANT}.json and returns only operational status; no profile or write grants. Deliberately unavailable to SYSTEM_ROLE runtimes.

generation_scheduler.description: EV-01: media-generation schedule daemon authority. Owns the generation schedule registry and its trigger deliveries; deliberately narrower than chronos_gateway, which has no write scope over media-generation state.

infrastructure_sentinel.description: Shared core role assumed internally by coordination store writers (work coordination, peer messaging, mesh, the stimuli journal) and by resident dots whose charters bind it (e.g. repo-guardian). Narrow coordination/observability/runtime write scope only — it reports and delegates, it does not reconfigure.

knowledge_steward.description: Knowledge maintenance authority across governed knowledge trees.

mission_controller.description: Mission lifecycle authority with mission state and observability write access.

nexus_daemon.description: EV-03: KANS nerve daemon authority. Routes stimuli, dispatches terminal work, and raises governed reflex wake triggers. Already declared in security-policy.json for secure-io write scopes; registered here so its reflex triggers carry an authority snapshot the trigger gate can verify (an unregistered role is rejected outright).

operational_learning_writer.description: Narrow internal store-writer for machine-generated organization learning proposals, bound to one organization and tenant execution scope.

organization_operator.description: Tenant-scoped organization operator role assumed by organization management scripts and resident dots overseeing organization operations, services, and cadences.

qa_lead.description: Quality assurance authority for test strategy, coverage validation, and regression evidence.

ruthless_auditor.description: Independent audit authority for evidence inspection, verdict issuance, and mission-halt power.

scope_locale_reader.description: IT-05/S2: least-privilege reader of a tenant's stored reply locale (knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/locale.json). libs/core locale resolution assumes it, bound to the turn's tenant scope, so surface runtimes whose role cannot read the confidential tier still reply in the tenant locale; it grants that single file only and no write (persona worker).

slack_bridge.description: Slack gateway authority for channel ingress and observability.

software_developer.description: Implementation authority for test and product code paths.

sovereign_concierge.description: Personal onboarding and identity synchronization authority.

surface_runtime.description: Surface runtime authority for reconciling and supervising managed surfaces.

system_configurator.description: Configuration authority for intentional, governed changes to Kyberion's own capabilities. Covers service integration setup, voice engine registration, and tenant bootstrapping. Changes under this role are always executed via a config mission — not ad-hoc.
